title: Create Alpine - Aeronautics
description: Create modpack based on travelling across different terrain, settling colony, making airships to travel across mountain peaks.
body:
### About Create Alpine
Create Alpine is an engineering and exploration-focused modpack built for NeoForge 1.21.1. The pack centers on massive automation, mechanical logistics, and world-scale infrastructure. Instead of magic blocks that do all the work instantly, this pack forces you to think about spatial design, power distribution, and physical transportation.

Your journey starts on the ground with basic mechanical components and eventually scales up to massive automated supply lines that cross continents.


### ⚙️ Rotational Power & Automation
Using the Create mod, your factories rely on actual physics and mechanical movement. You will design, optimize, and maintain complex assembly lines powered by water wheels, windmills, and steam engines. Every belt, gear, piston, and fluid pipe matters as you automate everything from basic resource processing to high-tier item assembly.

### ⚓ Airships & Sky Logistics
The horizon isn't just for looking at—you can build custom, fully functional airships to fly through it. Construct massive cargo vessels to move your factory components across the map, build mobile scouting platforms to map out new lands, or station a floating base right above your main mining quarry.

### 🏔️ Enhanced World Generation
The terrain has been completely overhauled to create massive mountain ranges, deep river valleys, and diverse biomes. The world feels grand and rugged, giving you the perfect terrain to cut massive train tracks through canyons, build suspension bridges, or carve automated factories directly into the sides of mountains.

### 🏰 Colony Building & Infrastructure
You are not alone in this world. Establish and manage thriving colonies, watching your citizens build houses, farm crops, and run local industries. As your settlements grow, you will need to link your far-flung colonies together using advanced Create rail networks and your fleet of cargo airships to keep resources flowing between them.

### Technical & Performance Notes
**Client-Side Optimization:** This pack includes modern rendering optimization mods to ensure your game stays smooth, even when massive factories are spinning and custom airships are flying through high-render-distance terrain.

**Server Compatibility:** Built to run efficiently on both single-player worlds and dedicated multiplayer servers. All heavy processing is optimized to keep server tick rates stable during automation setups.

**Installation:** Download the pack directly through your launcher, ensure you are allocating at least 4-6 GB of RAM for optimal performance, and you are ready to start building.
